description: This file defines the MetaData class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It provides JSON-based data structures for versioning, service status, channels, bridges, server info, subsystems, and COM RPC proxies, along with service metadata interfaces and a template for service metadata registration.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Main class encapsulating various JSON data structures for plugin metadata, including version, service status, channels, bridges, server info, subsystems, and COM RPC proxies.

classes.name: MetaData::Version
classes.description: Represents version information with hash, major, minor, and patch components.

classes.name: MetaData::Service
classes.description: Contains service status information, including version, module, interface versions, and state.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel
classes.description: Represents communication channel details such as remote address, state, activity, ID, and name.

classes.name: MetaData::Bridge
classes.description: Details of a bridge including locator, latency, model, and security status.

classes.name: MetaData::Server
classes.description: Server information with thread pool status and pending requests.

classes.name: MetaData::Server::Minion
classes.description: Represents a minion process with ID, job, and run count.

classes.name: MetaData::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems and their availability.

classes.name: MetaData::COMRPC
classes.description: Represents COM RPC link with associated proxies.

classes.name: MetaData::COMRPC::Proxy
classes.description: Details of a single COM RPC proxy including interface ID, instance ID, and reference count.

methods.name: Service::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for Service class from Plugin::Config.

methods.name: Server::Clear
methods.description: Clears thread pool and pending requests.

methods.name: SubSystem::Add
methods.description: Adds a subsystem with its availability status.
